theorems.name: Submission.codim1_rdo_dg_ce_radial_cutoff
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (y : Euclid P) (ρ δ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → 0 < δ → ∃ ζ : Euclid P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ ∧ HasCompactSupport ζ ∧ (∀ z, 0 ≤ ζ z ∧ ζ z ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ z ∈ closedBall y ρ, ζ z = 1) ∧ tsupport ζ ⊆ closedBall y (ρ + δ) ∧ (∀ z, ‖fderiv ℝ ζ z‖ ≤ 3 / (2 * δ)) ∧ (∀ z, z ∉ ball y (ρ + δ) \ closedBall y ρ → fderiv ℝ ζ z = 0) ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t ≤ 1 → ∃ r : ℝ, ρ ≤ r ∧ r < ρ + δ ∧ {z | t ≤ ζ z} = closedBall y r
